prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. Two sisters aged 29 and 37 meet after a long separation on a quiet railway-station platform. One has long straight dark-blonde hair and rectangular glasses; the other has short dark curls and a round face. A plain suitcase stands beside them as they step toward each other with open bent arms and delighted, moved expressions. Use overcast daylight and an uncluttered station background. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 4:5 vertical photograph with both sisters clearly separated just before a hug. Give the taller long dark-blonde-haired sister narrow rectangular glasses and a lean frame, the shorter dark-curly-haired sister a full figure and round cheeks. Their open bent arms must connect naturally to the correct shoulders, no merged torsos or extra hands. Keep the suitcase and ordinary coats continuous through the bottom region; no fades or bands.
review: Reviewed full portrait: two distinct sisters meet on a quiet railway platform, one long dark-blonde-haired with rectangular glasses and one shorter, dark-curly-haired with a fuller build. Four open hands are visibly connected to the correct shoulders and arms, with plausible fingers; faces are delighted and separate. A plain suitcase, continuous coats and legs establish the reunion without synthetic blending. PNG 1122x1402.
